title: Rio Grande do Sul civil police run Operation Prima Lex in São Paulo against fake-lawyer scam
org: Polícia Civil do Rio Grande do Sul (NUCIBER)
geo_basis: operation carried out in São Paulo, as the police page states
summary: The Rio Grande do Sul Civil Police's cybercrime unit carried out Operation Prima Lex in São Paulo on the morning of 25 November, against a scam in which criminals pose as lawyers. The police page says it began after a victim from Pelotas lost more than R$ 100 mil. A court issued four arrest warrants and seven search warrants; two people have been arrested so far.
plain: Police in Rio Grande do Sul raided suspects in São Paulo over a scam where fraudsters pose as lawyers. The police say a victim from Pelotas lost more than R$ 100 mil; two people have been arrested so far.
exec: Police say criminals posing as lawyers took more than R$ 100 mil from one victim; two arrests so far.

evidence.quote: A investigação teve início após uma vítima de Pelotas sofrer um prejuízo superior a R$ 100 mil.

validation.note: Single page: the Rio Grande do Sul Civil Police's own release (read in this run).
